d: This episode features one woman who was convicted of fatally stabbing her boyfriend and dismembering his body. Then, another woman beats a 67-year-old woman and leaves her to die in a storage shed.
Even with many leads, including an overdose and chronic lupus, the pieces don't add up in a woman's death.
An otherwise healthy child had been complaining of stomach pains.
All signs point to foul play in the case of a dead hunter and the police fear that a killer is on the loose.
In an unprecedented double autopsy, Dr. G is determined to find out who is accountable for these odd deaths.
A woman who was convicted of murdering her lover while in a drug induced fight and a woman who killed her grandmother are featured.
The stories of one woman who was convicted of the death of her adopted daughter after a beating, and a handicapped man who was pushed into a river by his wife.
